description: This Java class `TestData` provides utility methods to generate mock data for testing purposes within a book project application. It includes methods to generate authors, books, publishers, tags, and assign shelves with realistic randomized attributes. It facilitates creating test entities and populating collections with sample data, aiding in development and testing.

classes.name: TestData
classes.description: Utility class for generating mock test data such as authors, books, publishers, and tags for testing the book project application.

methods.name: generateRandomNumberInRange
methods.description: Generates a random integer between 300 and 1000 inclusive.

methods.name: generateAuthors
methods.description: Creates a list of predefined authors.

methods.name: generateBooks
methods.description: Creates a list of Book objects with randomized attributes, associating authors, tags, shelves, and publishers.

methods.name: generatePublishers
methods.description: Creates a list of predefined publishers.

methods.name: generateListOfTags
methods.description: Creates a list of predefined tags.

methods.name: createBook
methods.description: Constructs a Book object with randomized attributes, linking authors, tags, shelves, and publishers.

methods.name: setPredefinedShelfForBooks
methods.description: Assigns predefined shelves to a list of books and adjusts their reading progress, dates, and ratings accordingly.
